name: Bell Buckle
summary: A run recorded with a Garmin watch on September 12, 2026.
notes: This is one recorded run (Garmin activity "Bedford County Running"), not a measured or official race course. The route was not checked against a published course map.
Only the file name and the watch's own location label were used to name it, so the place is approximate.

elevation.method: Smoothed with a 5-point moving average, then every rise and fall added up. An estimate from a watch's elevation sensor.
